mapper.select: select * from integration_schema.exchange_rate t where t.rate_type||'|'||t.from_currency||'|'||t.to_currency||'|'||t.effective_date::text in #{key}
mapper.insert:
insert into integration_schema.exchange_rate (rate_type,from_currency,to_currency,effective_date,raw_rate,from_factor,to_factor,quotation_method,normalized_rate,deleted,source_version,source_changed_at,payload_hash) values
(#{row.rateType},#{row.fromCurrency},#{row.toCurrency},#{row.effectiveDate},#{row.rawRate},#{row.fromFactor},#{row.toFactor},#{row.quotationMethod},#{row.normalizedRate},#{row.deleted},#{row.sourceVersion},#{row.sourceChangedAt},#{row.payloadHash})
on conflict (rate_type,from_currency,to_currency,effective_date) do update set raw_rate=excluded.raw_rate,from_factor=excluded.from_factor,to_factor=excluded.to_factor,quotation_method=excluded.quotation_method,normalized_rate=excluded.normalized_rate,deleted=excluded.deleted,source_version=excluded.source_version,source_changed_at=excluded.source_changed_at,payload_hash=excluded.payload_hash, synced_at=clock_timestamp() where integration_schema.exchange_rate.source_version <=< excluded.source_version
mapper.select: select count(*) from integration_schema.exchange_rate where (from_currency ilike #{search} or to_currency ilike #{search})
select * from integration_schema.exchange_rate where (from_currency ilike #{search} or to_currency ilike #{search}) order by id limit #{size} offset #{offset}
